BING CROSBY: THE SUPERSTAR WHO QUIETLY LET OTHERS SHINE
posts.description: One of the lesser-known chapters of Bing Crosby's life was his habit of helping fellow entertainers when their careers, finances, or health were in trouble. Friends and biographers often described Crosby as a man who kept a private "take care of" list of people he wanted to help.
